decision: Minimal host exit receipt, not forced takeover or a supervisor framework
confirmedRoot: 1.77 retains observed exit only in volatile executor memory until remote CAS succeeds. Host loss after cleanup and failed remote persistence destroys recoverable factual evidence.

selected.write: After successful owned cleanup/no-start observation, before remote quiescence persistence, save a signed atomic receipt in host data directory outside project workspace.
selected.read: Explicit same-attempt recovery only: verify signature, complete owner/project/Run/workspace/chat/request/worker/fence binding, current revision and no active local writer.
selected.settle: Replay factual persistence and fail/interrupted settlement only. Never replay native, edit, checks or external operations.
selected.key: Reuse existing host config encryption key with HMAC domain separation; no new project settings/hooks/key provisioning. Missing/rotated key means no usable host receipt.

rejected: Elapsed-time/PID/session/transcript-terminal inference: does not prove all owned cleanup completed.
User checkbox or admin force release: assertions are not exit evidence.
Automatic model retries or runtime takeover: could duplicate unresolved side effects.
Supervisor/lease/heartbeat framework: not needed to preserve an already observed fact; still cannot prove unknown external completion.
sideEffects: Host-local receipts require original trusted storage and signing key; new machine without them cannot recover.
Local write failure cannot invalidate successful remote settlement: retain original-host observation, report unavailable local receipt, attempt existing factual remote persistence once as before.
Receipts contain exit/accounting identities, never game files, credentials, passed checks or quality verdicts; no automatic deletion.
Key compromise/whole-host compromise is outside cryptographic record trust; normal native environment does not inherit host encryption key.
Existing old orphan writers have no newly manufactured receipt and remain blocked.
verification: Actual SIGKILL after local receipt before remote persistence, then reconstruct with same trusted host root/key and explicitly recover without repeated work.
Crash before receipt, missing/corrupt/wrong signature, mismatched identities/fence/Run, unknown external outcomes remain blocked.
Cleanup failure/active writer never emits usable exit receipt.
No-start receipt retains proof and later requires new authorization, not continue.
Source-save receipt recovery preserves saved/untouched bytes, pause and unaccepted result.
Normal native/debug/Question/change and store invariants regression; protected frontend/native files unchanged.
